props.name: allowThumbCrossing
props.description: Whether dragging can continue across another thumb when there is no minimum gap.

props.name: class
props.description: Class applied to the component root or trigger element.

props.name: classes
props.description: Family slot class defaults for this instance.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The default value of the input (uncontrolled).

props.name: disabled
props.description: Whether the input is disabled.

props.name: id
props.description: The ID of the input element.

props.name: inputRef
props.description: Optional inner input element ref.

props.name: inverted
props.description: Reverses value movement along the track.

props.name: marker
props.description: Whether to show visual step markers on the track, only applicable when `step` is defined and greater than 0.

props.name: max
props.description: Maximum value of the slider.

props.name: min
props.description: Minimum value of the slider.

props.name: minStepsBetweenThumbs
props.description: Minimum steps required between thumbs in a multi-thumb slider.

props.name: name
props.description: The name of the input element, used for form submission.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Callback when the slider selection changes during interaction.

props.name: onValueCommit
props.description: Callback when the slider selection change is committed.

props.name: orientation
props.description: Direction of keyboard and pointer value movement.

props.name: readOnly
props.description: Whether the input is read-only.

props.name: required
props.description: Whether the input is required.

props.name: size
props.description: Visual size of the component.

props.name: step
props.description:
Step increment between values.
When omitted, pointer movement is continuous.

props.name: style
props.description: Style applied to the component root or trigger element.

props.name: styles
props.description: Family slot style defaults for this instance.

props.name: value
props.description: The current value of the input (controlled).

props.name: variant
props.description: Visual treatment of the component.
